name: WorshipTools
shortDescription: A set of free church and worship-team applications for presentation, service planning, charts, rehearsal and people communications.
suitableContexts: Churches that need low-cost worship-team tools
Teams wanting a free people database alongside service planning

pricing.summary: WorshipTools publishes free access across its apps and optional Pro and Pro Plus plans for selected capacity, presentation and permissions features; current paid prices should be checked in the supplier’s signup flow.

startingPrice.qualifier: Free plan across the published WorshipTools app set

tiers.label: Free
tiers.detail: Published free access with selected storage, user and feature limits depending on the app

tiers.label: Pro
tiers.detail: Adds capacity and presentation features for eligible apps; ask the supplier for the current price

tiers.label: Pro Plus
tiers.detail: Adds higher capacity, advanced permissions and selected presentation resources for eligible apps

pricing.trialDetails: The supplier publishes a free plan rather than a time-limited evaluation for the core app set; ask whether a separate trial is offered.

editorial.assessment: WorshipTools is a useful counterweight to all-in-one paid systems when worship planning and basic people communications are the immediate needs. It should not be assumed to replace a full UK finance, Gift Aid or safeguarding administration workflow.
bestFor: Volunteer worship teams seeking free planning and presentation tools
Small churches testing a free people database and communications tool
strengths: Purpose-built tools cover planning, presentation, charts and rehearsal
limitations: Ask the supplier about Paid Pro and Pro Plus prices
Ask the supplier about Gift Aid and wider UK administration requirements

procurementVerdict.problem: Volunteer worship teams seeking free planning and presentation tools
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Ask the supplier about Paid Pro and Pro Plus prices

longForm.verdict: WorshipTools is best evaluated as a focused toolkit rather than a single system that owns every church process. Its free entry point is strong for worship teams, but a church should be explicit about which records and responsibilities stay in another system.

decisionLens.heading: Free tools still need a clear system of record.
decisionLens.text: Service plans, song data and people communications are valuable only when the church knows where authoritative member, consent, finance and safeguarding information lives. A free app can reduce friction without becoming the answer to every administrative job.

sections.heading: A worship-team starting point
sections.question: Can the team improve Sunday preparation without creating a fragmented data stack?
paragraphs: WorshipTools publishes free apps for presentation, service planning, chord charts, rehearsal and a people database. Its Community product describes people and household management plus email communications.

Start with one team and define the boundary: who maintains people records, how volunteer details are updated, what data may be stored, and how any existing directory or finance system remains authoritative.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an independent review score. Its assessment is based on WorshipTools’ published product and pricing information.
themes: Free access makes a team-level pilot practical.
The main operational question is whether the tools connect cleanly to the church’s existing system of record.
userFeedback.caveat: The absence of an independent review sample is a research gap, not a conclusion about user experience or product quality.

faq.question: Is WorshipTools free?
faq.answer: WorshipTools publishes free access across its core app set, with optional Pro and Pro Plus plans for certain capacity and advanced features. Check current app-specific plan details before relying on them.

faq.question: Can WorshipTools manage church people records?
faq.answer: Yes. The supplier’s Community product describes a free people database with households, custom fields, filters and email communications. Confirm whether it meets the church’s permissions and data-governance needs.

faq.question: Does WorshipTools support UK Gift Aid?
faq.answer: Do not assume WorshipTools replaces a UK giving, Gift Aid or charity-finance workflow. Ask the supplier to demonstrate any relevant capability.
